name: juju-grand-adventures
description: A little illustrated library of space adventures with Juliet, Uni, and Starbeard.

scripts.dev: npm run import-map && arcane dev --app juju-grand-adventures
scripts.import-map: npm run sdk:materialize && arcane import-map --app juju-grand-adventures
scripts.package: npm run import-map && arcane package --app juju-grand-adventures
scripts.bundle: npm run import-map && arcane bundle --app juju-grand-adventures
scripts.build: npm run import-map && arcane build --target browser --app juju-grand-adventures
scripts.run: npm run import-map && arcane run --target browser --app juju-grand-adventures
